keys.swarm.aura_spark_mines_desc: Mines are dropped behind you as you walk and blow up when a monster steps on them.
keys.swarm.aura_spark_mines_ten: Minefield: a field of up to 30 mines.
keys.swarm.aura_eagle_eye_desc: A crosshair settles on a far monster, then a sniper shot hits it for a guaranteed critical.
keys.swarm.aura_eagle_eye_ten: Deadeye: you mark and shoot up to 6 of the farthest visible monsters.
